title: defectloop round outcome
description: Written by the agent at the end of a round, at the path given in the prompt. The supervisor normalises it: unknown fields are dropped, invalid enums are repaired, strings are truncated to maxLength.

summary.description: What the round did, in a few sentences.

followUps.description: Campaigns worth running in a later round (for example variants of a defect just found).

technique.description: Id of a technique in the catalog.

proposedTechnique.description: A new technique. Recorded for review; added to the catalog only when loop.acceptProposedTechniques is true.

status.description: fixed: corrected in a local commit with a test. proposed: needs a human decision. dismissed: suspected, then disproved (with evidence). unverified: could not be confirmed either way. Invalid values become unverified.

evidence.description: How it was proven: a failing test, a command and its output, a trace.

commit.description: Short sha of the fixing commit, when status is fixed.
